services.name: Rent a Kayak
services.desc: Longboards Paddle and Pedal Co offers kayak rentals at Wilkeson Pointe, presented by Independent Health. Longboards Paddle and Pedal Co at Outer Harbor provides the most amazing water sport rental experience for enjoying and exploring Buffalo’s booming waterfront. Visit www.longboardsbeach.com to make a reservation, complete your waiver and submit payment prior to arrival. Water sport rentals are presented by Independent Health. Independent Health Members receive 20% off of their rental by showing their insurance

services.name: Bike Ferry
services.desc: For only $1, catch the Queen City Bike Ferry between Canalside and the Outer Harbor, a five- to 10-minute scenic ride across the water. Runs seasonally from Memorial Day to Labor

services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: The Spirit of Buffalo is a 73-ft coastal sailing vessel which is the only square rigged, topsail schooner sailing out of the Historic Buffalo Harbor. The Harbor Queen offers Buffalo River tours and cruises around the Buffalo Harbor. Take a cruise on the historic Buffalo River and Inner Harbor on the coolest tiki boat in town! Buffalo River History Tours offers boat tours along the Buffalo River, including tours of Buffalo’s Grain

blurb: Canalside is free, open year-round, and offers kayak rentals, dining options, workout classes, and lake views. It is open to the public seven days a week from dawn to dusk, with extended hours during special events. Free parking is available at Canalside and the Outer Harbor.
